title: Enceladus — how to sample a hidden ocean

segments.en: An ocean hides under this ice. How does its water reach space?
segments.en_cap: An ocean hides | under this ice. | How does its water | reach space?

segments.en: This is Enceladus, a bright, frozen moon of Saturn just five hundred and four kilometers across.
segments.en_cap: This is Enceladus, | a bright, frozen moon | of Saturn just | 504 kilometers across.

segments.en: Cassini measured a tiny wobble in the frozen shell. Its motion revealed a global ocean separating the ice from the rocky interior.
segments.en_cap: Cassini measured | a tiny wobble | in the frozen shell. | Its motion revealed | a global ocean | separating the ice | from the rocky interior.

segments.en: At the south pole, fractures vent water vapor and tiny grains of ice into space.
segments.en_cap: At the south pole, | fractures vent water vapor | and tiny grains of ice | into space.

segments.en: Those grains carry salts from the ocean below.
segments.en_cap: Those grains carry salts | from the ocean below.

segments.en: Cassini data even revealed phosphates, a source of phosphorus essential to life on Earth.
segments.en_cap: Cassini data even revealed | phosphates, | a source of phosphorus | essential to life | on Earth.

segments.en: But ingredients are not organisms. Life has not been found here.
segments.en_cap: But ingredients | are not organisms. | Life has not | been found here.

segments.en: The ocean itself stays hidden. Its spray does not.
segments.en_cap: The ocean itself | stays hidden. | Its spray does not.

segments.en: A whole world, sealed in ice, sending pieces of its ocean out into space.
segments.en_cap: A whole world, | sealed in ice, | sending pieces | of its ocean | out into space.

segments.en: So, how do you reach it?
segments.en_cap: So how do you reach it?
